verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a Hosted Payment Page, described as a "pre-built, low-code payment page integration" and a "fully branded checkout page in less than a day". It has its own customization docs, so developers can take payments without building their own payment UI. The conversion-optimization claim is attached to Flow ("helps you boost conversions") rather than to the hosted page, and the redirect mechanics are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the redirect/session flow, conversion-optimization evidence specific to the hosted page, independent or hands-on corroboration.
